newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben not to enter sports arena.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben not to enter sports arena.

text.p: ProSieben Media AG chairman Georg Kofler said on Monday the company, fresh from a bourse debut, would not for the time being compete for the rights to broadcast sporting events.
"We will continue to concentrate on movies, series, animation and situation comedies," Kofler said.

"With aggressive acquisitions, we have a wealth of programming in these areas that is not vulnerable to short-term price fluctuations," he said, adding that the group owned the rights to over 30,000 hours of programming.
Three-quarters of the rights reach beyond the year 2000, Kofler said.
Kofler announced earlier on Monday that ProSieben Media AG also planned to remain out of the pay TV market, saying the costs and risks of applying for the right to participate were too high.
